configuration_selection_criterion: Required-answer schema completion and deployment protocol only; forecast accuracy was not evaluated.
deployment_differences_from_opus_4_8: Opus 5 rejects `temperature` as deprecated, so none is supplied. The Opus 4.8 run supplied none either, so the two runs match on this parameter.
Opus 5 returns an extended-thinking block ahead of its answer, so the reply is read from the first text block rather than from content[0].
